title: Trichostatin D as a Novel KLF2 Activator Attenuates TNFalpha-Induced Endothelial Inflammation.
authors: Lei, Lijuan; Chen, Minghua; Wang, Chenyin; Jiang, Xinhai; Li, Yinghong; Wang, Weizhi; Li, Shunwang; Zhao, Liping; Sheng, Ren; Han, Jiangxue; Zhang, Yuyan; Chen, Yuchuan; Yan, Biying; Wu, Yexiang; Yu, Liyan; Si, Shuyi; Xu, Yanni
one_liner_zh: 该文发现微生物代谢物TSD通过抑制HDAC上调KLF2并减轻内皮炎症，虽涉及转录因子KLF2但核心是药物筛选与信号通路，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅分子对接辅助，与课题关联弱。
abstract: Kruppel-like factor 2 (KLF2) is an atherosclerotic protective transcription factor that maintains endothelial cell homeostasis through its anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidant, and antithrombotic properties. The aim of this study was to discover KLF2 activators from microbial secondary metabolites and explore their potential molecular mechanisms. By using a high-throughput screening model based on a KLF2 promoter luciferase reporter assay, column chromatography, electrospray ionization mass spectrometry (ESI-MS), and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra, trichostatin D (TSD) was isolated from the rice fermentation of Streptomyces sp. CPCC203909 and identified as a novel KLF2 activator. Real-time-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) results showed that TSD upregulated the mRNA level of KLF2 in endothelial cells. Functional assays showed that TSD attenuated monocyte adhesion to endothelial cells, decreased vascular cell adhesion protein 1 (VCAM-1) and intercellular adhesion molecule 1 (ICAM-1) expression, and exhibited an anti-inflammatory effect in tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNFalpha)-induced endothelial cells. We further demonstrated through siRNA and western blot assays that the effects of TSD on monocyte adhesion and inflammation in endothelial cells were partly dependent on upregulating KLF2 expression and then inhibiting the NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3)/Caspase-1/interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta) signaling pathway. Furthermore, histone deacetylase (HDAC) overexpression and molecular docking analysis results showed that TSD upregulated KLF2 expression by inhibiting HDAC 4, 5, and 7 activities. Taken together, TSD was isolated from the fermentation of Streptomyces sp. CPCC203909 and first reported as a potential activator of KLF2 in this study. Furthermore, TSD upregulated KLF2 expression by inhibiting HDAC 4, 5, and 7 and attenuated endothelial inflammation via regulation of the KLF2/NLRP3/Caspase-1/IL-1beta signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: Kruppel样因子2（KLF2）是一种动脉粥样硬化保护性转录因子，通过其抗炎、抗氧化和抗血栓特性维持内皮细胞稳态。本研究旨在从微生物次生代谢产物中发现KLF2激活剂，并探讨其潜在分子机制。利用基于KLF2启动子荧光素酶报告基因的高通量筛选模型、柱色谱、电喷雾电离质谱（ESI-MS）和核磁共振（NMR）谱，从链霉菌属（Streptomyces sp.）CPCC203909的大米发酵物中分离出曲古抑菌素D（trichostatin D, TSD），并将其鉴定为一种新型KLF2激活剂。实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）结果显示，TSD上调了内皮细胞中KLF2的mRNA水平。功能实验表明，TSD减弱了单核细胞对内皮细胞的黏附，降低了血管细胞黏附蛋白1（VCAM-1）和细胞间黏附分子1（ICAM-1）的表达，并在肿瘤坏死因子α（TNFα）诱导的内皮细胞中表现出抗炎作用。我们进一步通过siRNA和western blot实验证明，TSD对内皮细胞中单核细胞黏附和炎症的影响部分依赖于上调KLF2表达，进而抑制NOD样受体蛋白3（NLRP3）/Caspase-1/白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）信号通路。此外，组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）过表达和分子对接分析结果表明，TSD通过抑制HDAC 4、5和7活性来上调KLF2表达。综上所述，本研究从链霉菌属（Streptomyces sp.）CPCC203909的发酵物中分离出TSD，并首次报道其为KLF2的潜在激活剂。此外，TSD通过抑制HDAC 4、5和7上调KLF2表达，并通过调节KLF2/NLRP3/Caspase-1/IL-1β信号通路减轻内皮炎症。
